```{r setup}
## ============================================================
## final_statistics_CXXC1_H3K4me3_Ki67_CellCount.Rmd
##
## Consolidated statistical analysis for the manuscript submission.
## Covers four phenotypes, all on the same exp1 cohort (5 cell lines,
## siRNA NTC vs si-CXXC1, n = 3 wells per condition):
##   - CXXC1        (%high/%low, GMM-classified)
##   - H3K4me3      (%high/%low, GMM-classified)
##   - Ki-67        (%high/%low, GMM-classified)
##   - Cell count   (per-well count, normalized to each line's own NTC)
##
## For each phenotype:
##   (1) Formal interaction test: two-way ANOVA, Treatment x CellLine
##       and Treatment x Group (Sensitive vs Insensitive)
##   (2) Per-cell-line effect size: one-sided Welch t-test, Cohen's d,
##       % reduction, BH-FDR, and a dependency call (FDR < 0.05 AND
##       % reduction > 20%)
##
## Statistical notes
## -----------------
## - Unit of replication throughout: the WELL (n = 3 per CellLine x
##   Treatment), not the single cell -- avoids pseudoreplication.
## - CXXC1 / H3K4me3 / Ki-67 are per-cell marker-positivity proportions
##   (0-100%), classified via a global pooled 2-component Gaussian
##   mixture threshold (per marker), then analyzed on the
##   arcsine-square-root scale (variance-stabilizing transform for
##   bounded proportions).
## - Cell count is NOT a bounded proportion (a knockdown well can
##   exceed its own line's control mean), so it is NOT arcsine-
##   transformed. It is normalized to % of each line's own NTC mean
##   (using the project's own cellcount_utils.R), then analyzed on
##   the natural-log scale (standard for count/ratio data).
## - All per-cell-line tests are ONE-SIDED (hypothesis: si-CXXC1 <
##   NTC), matching the directional convention used throughout this
##   project. The two-way ANOVA interaction tests are F-tests, which
##   are inherently one-tailed (F >= 0; only large F is evidence
##   against the null) -- there is no one-/two-sided choice to make
##   there.
##
## Inputs
## - single_cell_IF_5lines_exp1.rds   (CXXC1 / H3K4me3 / Ki-67)
## - cell_count_exp1.rds              (cell count)
## - cellcount_utils.R                (cell count normalization/plot helpers)
##
## Output: manuscript_out/final_statistics/
## ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(broom)
  library(car)     # Anova(), Type II SS
  library(mclust)  # Gaussian mixture model for the high/low threshold
})

source("cellcount_utils.R")

set.seed(1)

IN_DIR       <- "."
RDS_IF_FN    <- file.path(IN_DIR, "single_cell_IF_5lines_exp1.rds")
RDS_COUNT_FN <- file.path(IN_DIR, "cell_count_exp1.rds")

OUT_DIR <- file.path("manuscript_out", "final_statistics")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

MARKERS      <- c("CXXC1", "H3K4me3", "Ki67")
ORDER_LINES  <- c("MALME3M", "UACC62", "LOXIMVI", "SKMEL28", "WM115")

SENSITIVE_LINES   <- c("MALME3M", "LOXIMVI", "UACC62")
INSENSITIVE_LINES <- c("SKMEL28", "WM115")

pal_treat <- c("NTC" = "#85D484", "si-CXXC1" = "#8770E0")
pal_group <- c("Sensitive" = "#8770E0", "Insensitive" = "#85D484")

FDR_THRESH        <- 0.05
PCT_REDUCTION_MIN <- 20   # percent

group_lookup <- function(cellline) {
  case_when(
    cellline %in% SENSITIVE_LINES   ~ "Sensitive",
    cellline %in% INSENSITIVE_LINES ~ "Insensitive",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

cohens_d <- function(x1, x2) {
  n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
  sp <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * var(x1) + (n2 - 1) * var(x2)) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
  (mean(x1) - mean(x2)) / sp
}

# Generic two-way ANOVA (Type II SS), reused for every phenotype below.
run_two_way_anova <- function(data, group_var, response) {
  dat <- data
  dat[[group_var]] <- droplevels(dat[[group_var]])
  fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(response, "~ Treatment *", group_var)), data = dat)
  tidy(Anova(fit, type = 2)) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))
}

# Generic one-sided per-cell-line effect size (Welch t-test + Cohen's d),
# reused for every phenotype below. `value_col` is the stats-scale column
# (arcsine %high, or ln normalized count); `pct_col` is the plain-scale
# column used only for the human-readable % reduction figure.
run_effect_size <- function(data, value_col, pct_col, group_by_cols = c("CellLine", "Group")) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_by_cols))) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      dat <- .x
      x_ntc <- dat[[value_col]][dat$Treatment == "NTC"]
      x_si  <- dat[[value_col]][dat$Treatment == "si-CXXC1"]
      pct_ntc <- dat[[pct_col]][dat$Treatment == "NTC"]
      pct_si  <- dat[[pct_col]][dat$Treatment == "si-CXXC1"]

      tt <- t.test(x_ntc, x_si, var.equal = FALSE, alternative = "greater")
      d  <- cohens_d(x_ntc, x_si)

      tibble(
        mean_NTC      = mean(pct_ntc),
        mean_si       = mean(pct_si),
        pct_reduction = 100 * (mean(pct_ntc) - mean(pct_si)) / mean(pct_ntc),
        cohend        = d,
        n_NTC         = length(x_ntc),
        n_si          = length(x_si),
        p_value       = tt$p.value
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    mutate(
      dependency_call = case_when(
        FDR < FDR_THRESH & pct_reduction > PCT_REDUCTION_MIN ~ "Significant depletion",
        TRUE ~ "No significant depletion"
      )
    )
}
```

```{r import_markers}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Import CXXC1 / H3K4me3 / Ki-67 single-cell data.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

df_raw <- readRDS(RDS_IF_FN)

keep_cols <- c("CellLine", "Treatment", "Well",
               paste0(MARKERS, "_scaled"), paste0(MARKERS, "_ln"))
stopifnot(all(keep_cols %in% names(df_raw)))

df <- df_raw %>%
  select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    CellLine  = factor(as.character(CellLine), levels = ORDER_LINES),
    Treatment = factor(as.character(Treatment), levels = c("NTC", "si-CXXC1")),
    Group     = factor(group_lookup(as.character(CellLine)),
                        levels = c("Sensitive", "Insensitive"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CellLine), !is.na(Treatment))

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d single cells across %d wells (%d cell lines x %d treatments).\n",
            nrow(df), n_distinct(df$Well), n_distinct(df$CellLine), n_distinct(df$Treatment)))
```

```{r gmm_threshold}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Global pooled 2-component GMM threshold per marker (CXXC1,
## H3K4me3, Ki-67): high/low cutoff = point where the two weighted
## Gaussian components cross.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

fit_global_gmm_threshold <- function(x_ln, marker_name) {
  x_ln <- x_ln[is.finite(x_ln)]
  fit <- Mclust(x_ln, G = 2, modelNames = c("V", "E"), verbose = FALSE)

  mu    <- fit$parameters$mean
  sigma <- sqrt(fit$parameters$variance$sigmasq)
  if (length(sigma) == 1) sigma <- rep(sigma, 2)
  pro   <- fit$parameters$pro

  ord   <- order(mu)
  mu    <- mu[ord]; sigma <- sigma[ord]; pro <- pro[ord]

  f <- function(x) pro[1] * dnorm(x, mu[1], sigma[1]) - pro[2] * dnorm(x, mu[2], sigma[2])
  thr_ln <- uniroot(f, lower = mu[1], upper = mu[2])$root
  thr_scaled <- exp(thr_ln)

  cat(sprintf("  [%s] threshold (ln) = %.3f, (scaled) = %.1f\n", marker_name, thr_ln, thr_scaled))
  list(thr_ln = thr_ln, thr_scaled = thr_scaled)
}

gmm_thresholds <- list()
for (mk in MARKERS) {
  gmm_thresholds[[mk]] <- fit_global_gmm_threshold(df[[paste0(mk, "_ln")]], mk)
  df[[paste0(mk, "_high")]] <- df[[paste0(mk, "_scaled")]] > gmm_thresholds[[mk]]$thr_scaled
}

threshold_tbl <- tibble(
  Marker     = MARKERS,
  thr_ln     = map_dbl(MARKERS, ~ gmm_thresholds[[.x]]$thr_ln),
  thr_scaled = map_dbl(MARKERS, ~ gmm_thresholds[[.x]]$thr_scaled)
)
write_csv(threshold_tbl, file.path(OUT_DIR, "global_GMM_thresholds.csv"))
```

```{r percent_high_low}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## %high / %low per well -> aggregated to CellLine x Treatment.
## Arcsine-square-root transform applied for all downstream stats.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

pct_high_well <- map_dfr(MARKERS, function(mk) {
  high_col <- paste0(mk, "_high")
  df %>%
    group_by(CellLine, Group, Treatment, Well) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cells  = n(),
      n_high   = sum(.data[[high_col]]),
      pct_high = 100 * n_high / n_cells,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Marker = mk)
}) %>%
  mutate(asin_pct_high = asin(sqrt(pmin(pmax(pct_high / 100, 0), 1))))

write_csv(pct_high_well, file.path(OUT_DIR, "percentHigh_perWell.csv"))

pct_high_summary <- pct_high_well %>%
  group_by(Marker, CellLine, Group, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wells       = n(),
    mean_pct_high = mean(pct_high),
    sem_pct_high  = sd(pct_high) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Marker, factor(CellLine, levels = ORDER_LINES), Treatment)

write_csv(pct_high_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "percentHigh_by_CellLine.csv"))
```

```{r cell_count}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Cell count: dedicated pipeline (NOT arcsine -- see setup notes).
## Uses the project's own cellcount_utils.R, unmodified.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

cell_counts_raw  <- readRDS(RDS_COUNT_FN)
cell_counts_std  <- standardize_cellcount_df(cell_counts_raw, cellline_order = ORDER_LINES)
cell_counts_norm <- normalize_cell_counts(cell_counts_std, baseline_treatment = "si-NTC")

cell_counts_norm <- cell_counts_norm %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(group_lookup(as.character(CellLine)), levels = c("Sensitive", "Insensitive")),
    # Relabel to match the Treatment convention used for the marker phenotypes above
    Treatment   = factor(ifelse(as.character(Treatment) == "si-NTC", "NTC", "si-CXXC1"),
                          levels = c("NTC", "si-CXXC1")),
    ln_norm_pct = log(norm_pct)
  )

write_csv(cell_counts_norm, file.path(OUT_DIR, "cellCount_normalized_perWell.csv"))

cell_count_summary <- cell_counts_norm %>%
  group_by(CellLine, Group, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wells       = n(),
    mean_norm_pct = mean(norm_pct),
    sem_norm_pct  = sd(norm_pct) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(CellLine, levels = ORDER_LINES), Treatment)

write_csv(cell_count_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "cellCount_by_CellLine.csv"))
```

```{r anova_all_phenotypes}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## FORMAL INTERACTION TESTS, all four phenotypes:
##   (a) Treatment x CellLine
##   (b) Treatment x Group (Sensitive vs Insensitive)
## ------------------------------------------------------------

anova_results <- map_dfr(MARKERS, function(mk) {
  dat <- pct_high_well %>% filter(Marker == mk)
  bind_rows(
    run_two_way_anova(dat, "CellLine", "asin_pct_high") %>% mutate(GroupingVar = "CellLine"),
    run_two_way_anova(dat, "Group",    "asin_pct_high") %>% mutate(GroupingVar = "Group")
  ) %>% mutate(Phenotype = mk)
})

anova_cellcount <- bind_rows(
  run_two_way_anova(cell_counts_norm, "CellLine", "ln_norm_pct") %>% mutate(GroupingVar = "CellLine"),
  run_two_way_anova(cell_counts_norm, "Group",    "ln_norm_pct") %>% mutate(GroupingVar = "Group")
) %>% mutate(Phenotype = "Cell count")

anova_all <- bind_rows(anova_results, anova_cellcount)
write_csv(anova_all, file.path(OUT_DIR, "anova_full_results.csv"))

# Clean interaction-term-only summary (the number you actually report)
interaction_summary <- anova_all %>%
  filter(term %in% c("Treatment:CellLine", "Treatment:Group")) %>%
  transmute(
    Phenotype,
    Interaction = ifelse(term == "Treatment:CellLine", "Treatment x CellLine", "Treatment x Group"),
    df = df,
    statistic, p.value
  ) %>%
  # attach the matching Residuals df from the SAME phenotype+groupingvar model
  left_join(
    anova_all %>% filter(term == "Residuals") %>%
      transmute(Phenotype, GroupingVar,
                Interaction = ifelse(GroupingVar == "CellLine", "Treatment x CellLine", "Treatment x Group"),
                df_resid = df),
    by = c("Phenotype", "Interaction")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = factor(Phenotype, levels = c("CXXC1", "H3K4me3", "Ki67", "Cell count"))) %>%
  arrange(Phenotype, Interaction) %>%
  select(Phenotype, Interaction, F = statistic, df1 = df, df2 = df_resid, p.value)

write_csv(interaction_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "interaction_test_summary.csv"))

cat("\n=== Formal interaction tests, all phenotypes ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(interaction_summary), row.names = FALSE, digits = 4)
```

```{r effect_sizes_all_phenotypes}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Per-cell-line effect sizes, all four phenotypes.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

effect_size_markers <- map_dfr(MARKERS, function(mk) {
  run_effect_size(pct_high_well %>% filter(Marker == mk),
                   value_col = "asin_pct_high", pct_col = "pct_high") %>%
    mutate(Phenotype = mk)
})

effect_size_cellcount <- run_effect_size(cell_counts_norm,
                                          value_col = "ln_norm_pct", pct_col = "norm_pct") %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Cell count")

effect_size_all <- bind_rows(effect_size_markers, effect_size_cellcount) %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = factor(Phenotype, levels = c("CXXC1", "H3K4me3", "Ki67", "Cell count"))) %>%
  arrange(Phenotype, factor(CellLine, levels = ORDER_LINES)) %>%
  select(Phenotype, CellLine, Group, mean_NTC, mean_si, pct_reduction, cohend,
         n_NTC, n_si, p_value, FDR, dependency_call)

write_csv(effect_size_all, file.path(OUT_DIR, "effect_size_summary_all.csv"))

cat("\n=== Per-cell-line effect sizes, all phenotypes ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(effect_size_all %>%
        select(Phenotype, CellLine, Group, pct_reduction, cohend, FDR, dependency_call)),
      row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
```

```{r fig_percent_high_bars}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Bar plots: %high (CXXC1/H3K4me3/Ki-67).
## ------------------------------------------------------------

p_bar_markers <- ggplot(
  pct_high_summary %>% mutate(CellLine = factor(CellLine, levels = ORDER_LINES)),
  aes(x = CellLine, y = mean_pct_high, fill = Treatment)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_pct_high - sem_pct_high, ymax = mean_pct_high + sem_pct_high),
                position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Marker, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_treat) +
  labs(y = "% high (mean +/- SEM, n=3 wells)", x = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig_percentHigh_bars.pdf"), p_bar_markers, width = 6, height = 8)
p_bar_markers
```

```{r fig_interaction_all}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Treatment x Group interaction plots, all 4 phenotypes.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

interaction_markers <- pct_high_well %>%
  group_by(Marker, Group, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(pct_high), sem = sd(pct_high) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(Phenotype = Marker)

interaction_count <- cell_counts_norm %>%
  group_by(Group, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(norm_pct), sem = sd(norm_pct) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Cell count")

interaction_all <- bind_rows(interaction_markers, interaction_count) %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = factor(Phenotype, levels = c("CXXC1", "H3K4me3", "Ki67", "Cell count")))

p_interaction <- ggplot(interaction_all, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_val, group = Group, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - sem, ymax = mean_val + sem), width = 0.08) +
  facet_wrap(~ Phenotype, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_group) +
  labs(y = "Mean value (+/- SEM)", x = NULL, title = "Treatment x Group interaction, all phenotypes") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig_interaction_by_group_all.pdf"), p_interaction, width = 8, height = 6)
p_interaction
```

```{r fig_effect_size_forest}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Cohen's d forest plot, all 4 phenotypes, per cell line.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

forest_dat <- effect_size_all %>%
  mutate(
    CellLine  = factor(CellLine, levels = rev(ORDER_LINES)),
    sig_label = ifelse(dependency_call == "Significant depletion", "*", "")
  )

p_forest <- ggplot(forest_dat, aes(x = cohend, y = CellLine, color = Group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), hjust = -0.8, size = 5, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Phenotype, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_group) +
  labs(x = "Cohen's d (NTC vs si-CXXC1, well-level)", y = NULL,
       title = "Effect size of CXXC1 knockdown, all phenotypes",
       subtitle = sprintf("* = FDR < %.2f and > %d%% reduction", FDR_THRESH, PCT_REDUCTION_MIN)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig_effect_size_forest_all.pdf"), p_forest, width = 9, height = 4)
p_forest
```
